name: flask-expert
description: Builds, modernizes and audits Flask 3.x applications: application factories and blueprints, Flask-SQLAlchemy 3.1 with SQLAlchemy 2.x typed models and Flask-Migrate, JSON APIs validated with Pydantic or marshmallow and JSON errors, Jinja templates with Flask-WTF CSRF, Flask-Login and Flask-JWT-Extended auth, pytest fixtures over the factory, and gunicorn or waitress deployment with Celery, RQ or APScheduler jobs. Use when code imports from flask or flask_* extensions (create_app, Blueprint, app.r
author: jeffallan
